Feature Presentation
Projects

Translating ambiguous, high-stakes problems into scalable solutions.

For privacy and NDA compliance, my deep-dive case studies are password protected. Curious? [Drop me a line] and I’ll hand you the keys.

Lumi AI Camera

Multimodal agent that lets users point their camera at the world and talk to it naturally. This wasn't just object recognition, it was about creating an agentic companion that sees what you see, reasons about context, and responds with human-like empathy in real-time. The challenge? Designing an interface that feels 'magical' while solving for complex privacy and latency constraints.

Prism

A strategic overhaul of the Edge Add-ons Store, transforming it from a static repository into a dynamic, algorithmic discovery engine. We moved beyond simple lists to a modular card-based framework that adapts to user intent. This redesign solved critical trust barriers and successfully shifted the primary metric from simple 'downloads' to 'meaningful ecosystem engagement' for millions of users.

Takelessons

Architected a two-sided marketplace from the ground up to democratize education in India. Unlike generic platforms, we built a goal-centric ecosystem that connects students with mentors based on specific learning outcomes, not just subjects. This involved designing for 'next billion users' accessibility standards and solving deep localized trust issues—creating a seamless bridge between curiosity and mastery."

Experiments, explorations, and early wins. A collection of work showcasing my range from mobile apps and e-commerce systems to pure visual storytelling.

Deal Flux

Designing the 'pulse' of Bing Shopping. I created a real-time data visualization framework tracking price fluctuations. The goal? To turn volatile data into a clear 'Buy or Wait' signal, giving users the confidence to purchase instantly.

Amazon Brand Store

Empowering sellers as storytellers. I designed the 'Store Builder' framework: drag-and-drop modules allowing merchants with zero design skills to create immersive, pixel-perfect flagship stores within the Amazon ecosystem.

Solving 'last-mile' anxiety. I redesigned the rental journey to bridge the trust gap in unorganized markets. Introducing transparent pricing and digital KYC features significantly reduced drop-offs and boosted user retention.

My Journey
My Journey

Designing for the 'Next Billion' and the 'Next Big Thing.' I’ve spent 8+ years bridging the gap between user needs and business goals. Whether it was solving 'last-mile' trust for a mobility startup or architecting global AI ecosystems for Google, Microsoft, Amazon, my mission remains the same: removing friction from the systems that shape our lives.

Apr 2022 - Aug 2025

Product Designer II

I designed the core experience for Lumi Camera and the Edge Extension ecosystem, transforming static interfaces into intelligent, conversational partners. I shipped features that help millions of users 'see' and 'reason' with the web, defining new interaction patterns for the AI era.
Sep 2025 - Present

UX Designer III

Architecting the future of work. I am currently designing autonomous HR agents for People Ops—moving beyond static tools to build adaptive systems that collaborate with humans. My focus is on 'trust' and 'observability' in AI workflows.
May 2018 - Mar 2022

Visual Designer (UXD)

Mastering scale at Amazon. I learned that good design must also be scalable business. I built the self-service Store Builder frameworks that empowered millions of global sellers to craft unique brand stories, balancing strict system constraints with creative freedom.
Feb 2017 - Apr 2018

UI/UX Designer

Building the plane while flying. At a hyper-growth mobility startup, I owned the end-to-end rental experience. I turned operational chaos into a seamless digital journey, solving deep trust issues in the unorganized bike rental market to boost user retention.
Sep - Nov 2016

Associate Developer

The technical bedrock. Before designing screens, I built them. Writing production code for SAP interfaces and integrating REST APIs gave me a permanent advantage: I speak 'developer' fluently, allowing me to design solutions that are as shippable as they are beautiful.

1:1 Mentorship

My portfolio is messy (or non-existent). Should I wait to book?

Not at all. In fact, early-stage chaos is often the best time to talk. We don’t need a polished website to have a breakthrough. We can review raw Figma files, discuss your storytelling structure, or work on your personal positioning. I’d rather help you build the right foundation than critique a polished mistake.

I’m switching from Engineering (or another field) to Design. Can you help?

100%. I made that exact jump myself. I know the struggle of shifting from 'logic' to 'empathy.' I can help you translate your technical background into a unique superpower, showing recruiters why your diverse experience is an asset, not a liability.

What is your feedback style? Will you be nice?

I’m kind, but I’m not here to just pat you on the back. I believe in 'Radical Candor.' I won’t sugarcoat things because that doesn’t help you grow. Expect honest, direct, and constructive critique designed to push your work to a Senior or Big Tech standard.

How can I make sure I don't waste our time?

Come with a specific goal. 'Look at my portfolio' is okay, but 'I'm struggling to explain the problem statement in this project' is better. If you have links or specific questions, drop them in the booking note so I can prep beforehand. The more context you give me, the more value you get.
